name: Somchai Srisuwan
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Bangkok, he initially pursued a degree in engineering, but a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion he couldn't ignore. He started volunteering at the track, learning the ropes of logistics and eventually securing a full-time position. His meticulous nature and ability to anticipate potential problems quickly made him an invaluable asset to any team.

He joined Team WRT five years ago, drawn by their reputation for excellence and commitment to innovation. Somchai thrives on the fast-paced environment of the racing world. His approach is simple: preparation is key. He believes in having a contingency plan for every possible scenario, ensuring that the team's equipment and personnel are always where they need to be, when they need to be there. What makes him stand out is his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering dedication to the success of the team.

physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting his years of active involvement in motorsport logistics.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with detailed logistical plans.
Insists on drinking a specific type of Thai iced tea before every race.
Has a habit of double-checking everything, even after it's been verified by others.
